intro: Charming and cosy, this rectangular striped cotton cushion cover adds playful elegance to your space. With soft fabric and adorable pompoms on two sides, it brings warmth and character to any setting.

features.title: Only the best, nothing less
features.text: Made from breathable, high-quality cotton, this cover offers a soft texture and long-lasting durability, perfect for modern urban homes.

features.title: Mix, match, and make it yours
features.text: Its neutral stripes and playful pompoms make it easy to pair with various cushions, adding personality to sofas, beds, or chairs.
